oneLineBio: Wenyu Chiou is a Ph.D. candidate in Civil & Environmental Engineering at Lehigh University who builds empirically grounded simulations of how people decide under flood risk — and the fail-closed validation systems that show when AI agents can (and cannot) stand in for real people.
